prescribe.title: Prescribe
prescribe.needVisitBody: A prescription belongs to a consultation. Open a patient from today's queue to prescribe.
prescribe.draftNotice: Draft — not valid for dispensing until issued.
prescribe.startBody: Start a draft, add medicines, then issue it.
prescribe.notInReference: Not in the reference list — will be prescribed as typed.
prescribe.safetyPartial: Interaction check incomplete for some drugs — verify manually.
prescribe.safetyClean: No interactions or allergy conflicts found.
prescribe.noAllergiesRecorded: No allergy history recorded — nobody has asked yet.
prescribe.highBody: Review before continuing. You must acknowledge this to issue the prescription.
prescribe.issuedBody: {count} medicines issued. Medicine charges have been added to billing.
prescribe.mustAcknowledge: Acknowledge the safety warning before issuing.
prescribe.empty: Add at least one medicine before issuing.
prescribe.alreadyIssued: This prescription has already been issued.
prescribe.notPrescriber: Only the prescribing doctor can issue this.
prescribe.cancelNotPrescriber: This is another doctor's prescription. An admin can cancel it.
prescribe.cancelNotClinicalStaff: Only a doctor or an admin can cancel a prescription.
prescribe.notFound: That prescription could not be found.
prescribe.confirmCancelBody: It stops being administrable straight away — the nurse's screen will refuse the dose. Medicine charges not yet invoiced are removed.
prescribe.cancelReasonHelp: Recorded with the cancellation, e.g. allergy noticed after issue.
prescribe.cancelledBody: It can no longer be administered.
prescribe.chargesInvoiced: {count} charge is already on an issued invoice and was left alone — raise a credit note.

charges.unpriced: Needs a price — this line is ₹0, which means the price isn't known.
charges.noPending: There are no pending charges for this visit.

vitals.savedBody: Any pending vitals task for this patient has been closed automatically.
vitals.invertedBp: Diastolic is higher than systolic — please double-check.
vitals.noneYet: No observations recorded for this encounter yet.

consult.none: No notes recorded for this encounter yet.
consult.emptyNote: Empty note — saved with no content.

users.title: Users & roles
users.subtitle: Invite staff, change roles, and remove access.
users.noDeleteNote: Staff can't be deleted — medical records must keep pointing at whoever wrote them. Removing access deactivates the account instead.
users.inviteResentBody: The previous link has expired and no longer works. Share the new one.
users.inviteLinkNote: Email delivery isn't built yet — copy this link and send it yourself.
users.loadError: Couldn't load users. Please try again.
users.cannotDeactivateSelf: You can't remove your own access. Ask another admin to do it.
users.cannotDeactivateLastAdmin: Your clinic needs at least one active admin. Promote someone else first.
users.cannotDemoteLastAdmin: Your clinic needs at least one admin. Promote someone else first.

settings.title: Clinic settings
settings.subtitle: Your clinic's billing and tax details.
settings.tierNote: Set by the platform — not editable here.
settings.gstRegistered: This clinic is registered for GST
settings.gstRegisteredHelp: Registration depends on turnover (₹20 lakh generally, ₹10 lakh in some states). A clinic below the threshold legitimately issues non-GST bills.
settings.gstWarning: This changes the legal nature of every invoice issued afterwards: registered clinics issue a TAX INVOICE with rate-wise GST, unregistered ones a BILL OF SUPPLY with no tax section. Invoices already issued keep the details they were created with.
settings.defaultFeeHelp: Used when a doctor has no fee of their own set.
settings.gstinRequired: A GSTIN is required to register for GST.
settings.loadError: Couldn't load settings. Please try again.
settings.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
settings.networkError: No internet connection — please check your network.
settings.permissionError: You don't have permission to change these.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.clinicDayNote: A clinic day runs 05:30 to 05:30, matching the queue screen.
dashboard.notAdminBody: These reports are limited to clinic admins.
dashboard.admittedWithoutBedNote: Admitted patients waiting for a bed — this is why inpatients can exceed occupied beds.
dashboard.activityNote: Recorded activity and real consulting time. This is not utilization — there is no roster or shift data to measure against.
dashboard.untimedNote: Consultations missing a start or end stamp contribute no minutes, so the average reflects only timed ones.
dashboard.noActivity: No recorded activity for this clinic day.
dashboard.loadError: Couldn't load the dashboard. Please try again.

invite.title: You've been invited
invite.needAccount: Create your account first — we'll bring your invite along.

portal.notReadyBody: We're still building the patient view. Nothing is missing from your record — this screen just can't show it yet.
portal.askReception: Please ask at the reception desk for your token number or reports.

rounds.title: Ward rounds
rounds.subtitle: Inpatients, least recently observed first.
rounds.emptyBody: Admitted patients appear here. An OPD-only clinic won't have any.
rounds.noBedNote: Admitted and waiting for a bed.
rounds.neverObservedNote: Nothing recorded this admission — the most overdue patient on the ward.
rounds.mixedTimesNote: Each figure is the latest known value for that measurement, so ages differ.
rounds.loadError: Couldn't load rounds. Please try again.

reconciliation.title: Billing reconciliation
reconciliation.subtitle: Anything that looks wrong, worst first.
reconciliation.readOnlyNote: This only reports — it never adjusts money. Open the invoice to correct anything.
reconciliation.infoHiddenNote: Routine open charges are hidden so real problems stay visible.
reconciliation.loadError: Couldn't load reconciliation. Please try again.

beds.title: Ward beds
beds.subtitle: Capacity by ward. Who is in a bed appears on rounds.
beds.tierLockedTitle: Inpatient management isn't on your plan
beds.tierLockedBody: Your clinic is on Tier 1, which covers OPD. Creating beds and admitting patients needs Tier 2. Existing beds stay visible.
beds.noClinic: You're not in a clinic yet
beds.noClinicBody: Set up or join a clinic first, then wards and beds appear here.
beds.wardNameHelp: A new ward is created automatically, unpriced.
beds.unpricedBody: An unpriced ward bills ₹0 for room rent. Set a rate before admitting anyone.
beds.occupiedNote: Occupied. Discharge or transfer from rounds.
beds.emptyBody: Add your first bed to start tracking ward capacity.
beds.emptyBodyTier1: Bed tracking is a Tier 2 feature. Nothing to show on an OPD-only plan.
beds.loadError: Couldn't load the ward board. Please try again.
beds.accrualSubtitle: Accruing on open stays. Nothing here has been charged yet — it appears on the invoice at discharge.
beds.bedTaken: That bed was taken while you were looking. The list has been refreshed.
beds.transferred: Moved from {from} to {to}. The old bed is now for cleaning.
beds.unpricedWarning: This ward has no rate set, so room rent will bill ₹0.
beds.admitNote: Admitting is separate from the consultation — it won't change the visit's status.
beds.anyStaffMayAdmit: Any staff member can record an admission
beds.noBedToRelease: No bed to release — this patient was admitted without one.
beds.noSummaryNote: No discharge summary is recorded yet — that field doesn't exist in this build.

labs.title: Lab orders
labs.subtitle: Diagnostics ordered, and results as they come in.
labs.alertsSubtitle: Critical values, and results that couldn't be checked at all.

checkStatus.no_reference: No thresholds on file for this test. This is not the same as normal — verify against the lab's own range.
checkStatus.unparseable_value: The result isn't a number, so no threshold comparison was possible. Verify manually.
checkStatus.unit_mismatch: The reported unit doesn't match the reference unit, so no comparison was made.
checkStatus.evaluation_failed: The check itself failed. Treat this as unverified and check manually.

labs.notClinicalStaff: Only clinical staff can do that.
labs.emptyBody: Order a test from the queue and it appears here.
labs.loadError: Couldn't load lab orders. Please try again.
labs.invalidTransition: That order can't move to that status.
labs.alreadyInvoiced: The charge is already on an issued invoice, so it wasn't withdrawn. Raise a credit note instead.
labs.testNameHelp: Free text — anything the lab can run.
labs.priorityNote: Priority labels the nurse's collection card. There's no scheduler, so every order is due now.
labs.cannotOrder: Only a doctor or admin can order a test.
labs.orderedEffects: A ₹0 charge is waiting for billing to price, and the nurse has a sample-collection card.
labs.resultValueHelp: Numbers or words — 6.9, Reactive, No growth.
labs.referenceRangeHelp: As printed by the lab. Display only.
labs.orderCancelled: This order was cancelled, so no result can be recorded.
labs.savedCritical: Saved — critically {direction}. Inform the treating doctor now.
labs.savedUnevaluated: Saved, but not evaluated. Verify against the lab's own range.
labs.needsAcknowledgement: This needs acknowledging before it clears from the alert list.
labs.collectionCardClosed: The nurse's sample-collection card is closed.
labs.noPriceListNote: Lab charges land at ₹0 because there's no price list in this build. Billing prices them on the invoice.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Who changed access, invites and clinic settings.
audit.privacyTitle: Values are recorded only for non-personal fields
audit.privacyBody: Roles, access and clinic settings keep their before-and-after values. Clinical content, patient details, invite emails and tokens are recorded as changed but never stored here.
audit.emptyBody: Role changes, invites and settings changes appear here.
audit.adminOnly: Only an admin can read the audit log.
audit.loadError: Couldn't load the audit log. Please try again.
audit.scopeNote: This build logs access, invites and clinic settings. Clinical and billing changes aren't logged yet.

administer.title: Give medicines
administer.subtitle: Scan the wristband, then record each dose.
administer.scanHelp: Scan the band, or type the UHID. 12, UHID-12 and P/12 all work.
administer.scanPrivacyNote: Only how the code resolved is recorded, never the scanned code itself.
administer.scanFirst: Scan the wristband to enable recording.
administer.emptyBody: Only issued prescriptions appear here. A draft was never authorised, and a cancelled one must not be given.
administer.loadError: Couldn't load the medicine list. Please try again.
administer.noDoseRecorded: No dose recorded on the prescription
administer.notesHelp: Applies to the next dose you record. Useful for a refusal or a hold.
administer.patientVerified: Right patient confirmed against the scan.
administer.notVerified: The patient was not verified, so nothing was recorded.
administer.mismatchBody: That wristband belongs to a different patient. Check you're at the right bedside before doing anything else.
administer.mismatchNothingRecorded: Nothing was recorded. The other patient's details aren't shown on purpose — the next step is to stop, not to look them up.
administer.unrecognisedTitle: That code didn't match any patient here
administer.unrecognisedBody: Re-scan, or verify the patient by hand. A smudged band and a band from another clinic look the same to the scanner.
administer.scanRequiredBody: A dose can't be recorded without a patient check.
administer.notIssuedTitle: This prescription hasn't been issued, so the drug was never authorised.
administer.cancelledTitle: This prescription was cancelled. Do not administer.
administer.repeatBody: Record it again only if this is a genuine subsequent dose.
administer.repeatBodyWithTime: Last given {time}. Record again only if this is a genuine subsequent dose.
administer.repeatStillVerified: The patient check passed — this is about the dose, not the patient.
administer.appendOnlyNote: This log can't be edited or undone yet. Record a hold or a refusal rather than leaving a dose unlogged.

checkIn.inQueue: They're in today's queue and visible to the doctor now.
checkIn.alreadyInQueue: They were already in today's queue with this token. A second one isn't issued, so they can't be charged twice.
checkIn.notStaff: Only clinic staff can check a patient in.
checkIn.notFound: That patient isn't registered at this clinic.

patients.title: Find a patient
patients.subtitle: Search by UHID, phone number or name, then check them in.
patients.searchHelp: A number is treated as a UHID, ten or more digits as a phone number, anything else as the start of a name.
patients.promptBody: Type a UHID, a phone number, or the start of a name.
patients.noResultsBody: Nothing at this clinic matches that. Check the spelling, or register them as new.
patients.loadError: Couldn't run that search. Please try again.
